audit_method: Generation-stage complete input streaming audit, then independent small-artifact consistency review; input bodies not scanned a second time.
full_audit_fields: body SHA excluding first header line
prior_registry_scope: Manifest-only SHA/seed/lineage comparison; no prior raw inputs or policy results read. R81 includes all current old38 inputs and DEV; R82 DEV used only as a seed/SHA registry.
pressure_deviation_interpretation: The unchanged dynamic model samples counts and bytes. These realized deviations from target 1.10 are retained, not corrected or resampled.

disjoint_checks.prior_scope: Manifest-declared identities only; not all possible historic seeds or input bodies re-audited.

dev_boundary: DEV uses independent seeds under the same predeclared mechanism/shape parameters. In particular IID Zipf structure is determined by the same family parameters; seed independence does not imply independent distributions or OOD. This panel is reserved development validation, not a blind official test set.
